strings.꿈과 희망이 가득한 춘식랜드에 오신 것을 환영합니다!: Welcome to Chunsik Land, where dreams and hopes come true!
strings.혹시 공사 관계자 분이신가요?: Are you here with the construction crew?
He said you needed someone to clear things out...
strings.아, 그 소문의 모험가님?!: Oh, the adventurer I've heard so much about?!
I was expecting some muscle-bound monster with three heads...
What kind of rumors are people spreading about me?
strings.아무튼, 제가 해야 할 일이 많거든요?: Anyway, I've got a lot to do, you know.
strings.빨리 용건만 알려주시면 고맙겠는데요?!: I'd appreciate it if you'd just tell me what you need!
So prickly. That just makes you cuter.
Apparently, someone cast a spell on this place...
And now the statues and mascots are all moving around.
They're running wild, so we can't get any work done for the reopening.
Oh, that... So it's still in effect.
strings.그런데 춘식랜드 리모델링 해서 재개장 하려는 거에요?: Wait, you're remodeling Chunsik Land and reopening it?
At first, I tried negotiating with them about permanent employment...
I can't possibly do all this alone while things are like this.
strings.그러면 움직이는 캐릭터 조형들을 어떻게 하면 될까요?: What should I do with the moving mascot figures?
Herd them into one place, or tie them up so they can't move...?
strings.일단 그렇게 해주시겠어요?: Could you do that for now?
strings.많은 방문객들을 만나봤지만, 그렇게 말씀해주시는 분은 처음이에요!: I've met plenty of visitors, but you're the first to say anything like that!
Nobody else offered to do what you just did.
strings.대단해요. 그 많은 캐릭터 조형들을 처리하시다니…. 제가 그정도 하려면: Amazing. You dealt with all those mascot figures... It would have taken me several more days.
strings.일하시는 요령이 대단하신데, 혹시 춘식랜드에 관심 있으세요? 이곳에서 일: You're incredibly efficient. Any interest in Chunsik Land? How would you like to work here?
Sorry. I'll just stick to this job.
I'm kidding. Anyway, now I need you to clear out the memorial hall.
That place is so revolting I don't even want to go inside.
Where did they come up with so many ugly characters with such bizarre backstories...?
strings.저기, 어쩌다가 이런 곳에서 근무하게 되었어요?: How did you end up working in a place like this?
One day, the owner came to my old workplace and offered me a new job.
strings.무엇보다도 업무에 관여하지 않고, 필요한 지원은 모두 해주겠다고 하셨어요: And above all, he promised not to interfere with my work and to give me all the support I needed.
Exactly. Before I knew it, I'd signed the contract he was waving in front of me...
Anyway, please hurry and clear out the Chunsik Land Memorial Hall.
I'm going to empty it completely and fill it with new attractions.
Sure. It shouldn't be too difficult...
You've cleared everything out nicely, even the Bong Chunsik Special Forces.
That should be enough for the memorial hall for now.
There's still more in there I could sweep away...
I think we should deal with the biggest problems first.
Now, next is the Ice Cream Garden.
For something the owner came up with, the concept is actually rather good...
So I'm adding more ideas to bring the quality up.
But the characters there are causing trouble too...
strings.그곳도 정리하면 되는 거죠?: So you want me to clear that place out as well?
Exactly. No need to bother with every little thing.
Just deal with the big ones.
We can gather up the smaller ones and dispose of them all at once.
...Still, they're characters that are alive and moving around.
Calling them trash is pretty cold.
strings.그런 대우 받기 싫었다면 제 협상안을 진지하게 생각하는 척이라도 했어야죠: If they didn't want to be treated that way, they should at least have pretended to consider my offer seriously.
It's not as if I was offering peanuts and planning to work them like servants.
strings.조건이 얼마나 좋았는데 그걸 싹 무시해 버렸다고요!: The terms were excellent, and they completely ignored them!
...Why are you getting angry at me?
Now all that's left is the Book of Shadows.
strings.뭐하는 곳이죠?: What kind of place is that?
It's something like the owner's private library...
And it's in chaos too, thanks to a spell, or a curse... some strange magic, anyway.
Hmm. If I had to describe that place in a single phrase...
strings.흑역사가 총 망라된 곳이라고나 할까?: A complete collection of his most embarrassing phases?
That's how I see it, though the owner seems to think it's a treasure trove.
Once you go inside, you'll find all sorts of books and paintings flying around.
And there's a dragon with some painfully melodramatic backstory making a racket...
You'll understand when you see it.
strings.예술을 빙자한 낙서만 가득한 더러운 곳이니까요!: It's a filthy place full of nothing but scribbles pretending to be art!
You really do get things done properly.
strings.사실, 제논 탐정님이 모험가 님을 추천하면서 입에 침이 마르도록 극찬했어: Actually, when Detective Xenon recommended you, he couldn't stop singing your praises.
He said you'd worked together on many cases and had never made a single mistake...
strings.아무튼, 덕분에 춘식랜드 재개장 작업을 본격적으로 진행할 수 있게 되었네: Anyway, thanks to you, we can finally get serious about preparing Chunsik Land to reopen.
I just did the job I was asked to do.
strings.아, 일하면서 생각했는데, 이름 바꾸는 게 어때요?: Oh, I was thinking while I worked. Why not change the name?
strings.춘식랜드… 너무 촌스럽지 않나요?: Chunsik Land... Isn't it a little tacky?
I thought so too... but the owner is adamant about that.
He said he wouldn't change it even with a knife to his throat.
strings.그래도 컨텐츠와 서비스가 좋으면 많이 찾아주실 거에요!: Still, if the attractions and service are good, plenty of people will come!
Oh, when you're done adventuring, come see me if you're looking for something to do.
I'll hire you on excellent terms! Hehe.
But I still have things to do.
There's someone I need to meet. I don't know when I'll be able to, though...
Anyway, I'm busy, so I'd better go.
strings.네! 조심히 돌아가세요!: Of course! Have a safe trip!
